changelog: Paraphrased C1 to a shorter, clearer prompt so we can add a new, targeted rule within size limits.

Replaced C7 with a rule addressing the primary finding: forbid cuts immediately after bound function morphemes or short degree/negation/comparative/aspectual prefixes unless the left fragment is independently entailed by the full sentence. This directly prevents isolated prefixes/adverbials from becoming contradictory or orphaned.
Paraphrased C1 to a shorter, clearer statement so we can add one targeted rule within size limits.

Inserted a new core principle to address the primary finding: forbid cuts inside multi-character named entities, transliterations and fixed technical terms across punctuation/parentheses unless the left fragment is independently entailed.
Replaced E1 with labeled example cmn_hans_cn_1140 to teach the scorer the primary finding (predicate-completion / causal/resultative danger) using a measured case.
Replaced E2 with labeled example cmn_hans_cn_299 to add another measured case showing predicate/predicate-completion failure modes.
Deleted E3 (large hand-written example) to reduce prompt size and remove a verbose, unsupported example.
Deleted E4 (largest hand-written example) to recover the character/word budget and keep the prompt within limits.

Inserted a targeted core principle to address the primary finding: forbid cuts immediately after bound function morphemes or short degree/negation/comparative/aspectual prefixes unless the left fragment is independently entailed by the full sentence, preventing isolated prefixes/adverbials from becoming contradictory or orphaned.
